educationalGoal: To get a teacher's license, five days of nursing care experience at social welfare facilities and two days of nursing care at special needs schools are required. This course consists of three parts. One is Pre-guidance for final preparation of the experience of nursing care, second is experience of nursing care, and the last is Post-guidance for reflection on the experience of nursing care. In Pre-guidance, students will acquire.
advice: 1. Pre-guidance Students will understand the significance of the experience of nursing care, and acquire basic knowledge of social welfare, special needs education, handicapped people, and elderly people. 2. The experience of nursing care Students will participate in five days of nursing care experience at social welfare facilities and two days of nursing care at special needs schools 3. Post-guidance For reflection on the experience of nursing care, students will discuss each experience and build the view of education and human based on the discussion.
books: The Understand for Special Needed Child: Useful Knoeledge and Skill for Nursing Care, Itsukki-Shobou (Tokubetsu no Kyouiku-teki Needs no Aru Kodomo no Rikai, Itsuki-Shobou.)
requiredKnowledge: ●This Course is required to get a teacher's license of junior high school. ●Students will participate in the experience of nursing care at facilities off campus.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the significance of the experience of nursing care.
Be able to answer the basic questions on social welfare and special need education.
Be able to answer the questions on social welfare facilities and special need school.
Be able to explain the suitable attitude which is required for the meaningful experience of nursing care.
Be able to explain the view of education and human based on the reflection on the experience of nursing care.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the significance of the experience of nursing care, and participate in the experience with a sincere attitude, and have sufficient human relationships in the field. (2)Reflect on the experience of nursing care, and consider the views of human and education necessary for teachers from the contents of the experience.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the significance of the experience of nursing care. (2) Reflect on the experience of nursing care.
